description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

Your mind has become a nexus for dark energies and spectral mists trail your body like ghostly apparitions. It looks truly disturbing. You can, with a successful Challenging (+0) Willpower Test, turn insubstantial for Willpower Bonus + SL Rounds. You gain the Creature Trait Ethereal for the duration and can pass through solid objects and can only be harmed by Magical attacks. If you turn solid with an arm or a leg inside a solid object, the limb is destroyed (see Amputation WFRP4e p180). If you get stuck with your body or head you die immediately. You suer a Minor Miscast if you Fumble your Willpower Test. You can only gain this mutation once.
